tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main colour (WITW green): primary button fill, links, active tab text and its 2px underline, active sidebar item, checked toggle, current page in pagination. As text on surface, primary-soft and background.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and primary text on hover. Console: a darker green. Portal: WITW's orange hover, exactly as the website (white text on it is 3.2:1, under 4.5:1 — kept as the source).

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: active sidebar item, role chip, KPI icon tile, unread notification row, text-button hover. Console: WITW soft green. Portal: WITW cream.

tokens.name: primary-soft-border
tokens.usage: Border of primary-soft elements (current pill tab's count chip). Console: primary at 30% on white (derived; WITW names no such tint).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (primary button label, sign-in panel).

tokens.name: accent-1
tokens.usage: Accent 1 (WITW yellow) — the 4px rule on the sign-in brand panel's right edge; decoration and charts. Not for text; dark text only when it is a ground.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Accent 2 (WITW orange) — rare highlights and the second chart series. Not for body text.

tokens.name: accent-3
tokens.usage: Accent 3 — decorative and chart use only; not for text. Portal: WITW lime (secondary).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 3px ring (box-shadow) around any focused control. Translucent primary (Portal: WITW's primary-50) — under 3:1 on surface (flagged).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background, behind cards and tables (WITW section grey).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, sidebar, dialogs, popovers, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Table head, pill-tab strip, row hover, secondary-button and icon-button hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Lines and card, table, header and sidebar borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and secondary-button borders; toggle track when off. WITW uses one border grey for inputs and cards: about 1.5:1 on surface — under the 3:1 for control borders (flagged).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Main text on background, surface, surface-alt and primary-soft.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, breadcrumb, column headings, inactive tabs, icon buttons) on background, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, input icons, empty cells (–), notification times. Console 5.3:1 on surface. Portal is WITW's #7A7A7A, 4.3:1 on surface — just under 4.5:1, kept as the source; never for body copy.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and behind the phone menu (the scrim under the header). Portal: WITW's primary-50.

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip background; tooltip text is surface.

tokens.name: required
tokens.usage: The * after a required field's label. Console: the AA-safe error red. Portal: WITW error (3.8:1 on surface, flagged).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error input borders, the error toast's line and icon, and the save-failed message in a dialog (on danger-soft). Console: a darker shade of WITW's #EF4444 so text meets AA (6.5:1). Portal: WITW error #EF4444 (3.8:1, flagged).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Danger button on hover. Portal: WITW's danger hover.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger (delete) button fill. Console: the AA-safe red. Portal: WITW's danger button yellow, exactly as the website.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label and icon on danger-fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the save-failed message inside a dialog, and of danger badges (the 50 tint of WITW's error red).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, active; the success toast's left line and icon; as text on surface and success-soft. Console: darker shade of WITW #10B981 for AA. Portal: WITW success (2.5:1 as text, flagged).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success messages.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, pending; as text on surface and warning-soft. Console: darker shade of WITW #F59E0B for AA. Portal: WITW warning (2.1:1 as text, flagged).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warnings.
